build_TwoStageDetector: build a two-stage detector with backbone, RPN head, and ROI head from config
extract_feat_TwoStageDetector: extract multi-level features from input image tensors using the backbone and neck
loss_TwoStageDetector: calculate RPN and ROI head losses from a batch of input images and data samples
predict_TwoStageDetector: predict detection results with bounding boxes, labels, and scores from input images
load_state_dict_TwoStageDetector: load single-stage model weights into a two-stage detector by remapping bbox_head keys to rpn_head
